name: haplotype-APR008-hap1-chr22-v1
identification: minimap2 2.28 -x asm5 of every APR008 hap1 scaffold against CHM13 v2.0 chr22 (job 32742987, freeze-d13/apr008-chr22): JBHMUJ010000002.1 covers chr22 17.4-51.3 Mb (33.85 Mb in alignments of at least 500 kb, 99.5 percent of the scaffold) and no other scaffold aligns there; chr22 0-17.4 Mb (short arm and centromere) is spread over at least 10 scaffolds shared with other acrocentrics and is not included
selection: the scaffold uppercased and split at every non-ACGT character into ACGT-only records
region: chromosome 22 long arm (q-arm) and pericentromeric sequence, CHM13 v2.0 chr22 17.4 to 51.3 Mb
excluded: chr22 short arm and centromere (CHM13 chr22 0 to 17.4 Mb): split over at least 10 APR008 hap1 scaffolds shared with the other acrocentric chromosomes, so it cannot be assigned to chr22
methods: Reads were simulated from the long arm of chromosome 22 of APR008 haplotype 1 (GenBank GCA_050494745.1, scaffold JBHMUJ010000002.1, 34.0 Mb), identified by whole-assembly alignment to CHM13 v2.0 chr22.
